notes.title: Demo Update: Roguekile Simple Progression
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We’re excited to share an update for the Canvas Infernum demo, introducing a first step into simple roguelike progression and many bug fixes.

We want to thank all the players who have taken the time to give us feedback so far, and let you know that from now on we’ll be active on the Steam Community Hub  posting news and updates about the game’s development. ːmonstertraininfernoː



We’re currently working hard on new features to boost replayability and fun, such as new Pacts, a Midgame Shop that sells special usable itens, and a Sandbox Mode.



Feel free to reach out anytime and let us know what you would like to see next, and we hope you enjoy the new update! Please keep in mind we’re a small team working on this project alongside our day jobs, but we’re doing our best to dedicate as much time as we can to the game.
